objective.name: wrapper.ping
objective.description: Bootstrap capacity used to start the Matter wrapper runtime

#root.role: Provide a minimal wrapper-backed call that forces lazy wrapper startup and acknowledges readiness.

effects.wrapper_runtime: The configured wrapper runtime may be started lazily.

transformation_contract.morphing: A bootstrap ping becomes an explicit proof that the Matter wrapper runtime is reachable.
invariants: wrapper.ping must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: wrapper.ping returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: wrapper.ping fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
